overview_description.description: attimet is an artificial intelligence research lab and quantitative development company that focuses on financial markets. The company develops internal research infrastructure that combines machine learning frameworks with live market data pipelines. Its systems support modeling and prediction of large-scale human behavior in high-dimensional financial contexts, with emphasis on options and equities. attimet builds and operates low-latency execution tools, temporal and reinforcement learning models, and automated feedback loops for continuous model improvement. This infrastructure enables quantitative researchers to backtest hypotheses, discover signals, and deploy algorithmic trading rules into production. Rather than offering consumer applications or public APIs, attimet concentrates on proprietary platforms for in-house quantitative research and trading strategy execution.
